title: Associate, Driver Operations
description: Official Lalamove role in Riyadh focused on driver operations and last-mile execution. The role covers helping develop driver acquisition processes, building and retaining an active driver community, growing branded vehicle presence, reporting daily to functional teams, aligning with local teams on new initiatives, and working in an operations- and process-driven environment. The role asks for 2-3 years of operations experience, strong communication, comfort influencing stakeholders, and spreadsheet-based data work.
